scope: Native supplied-label mathematical chain port only; no real images, detector, quality result, production integration or speed claim
language: C++17 with existing local GMP; do not vendor or publish dependencies
grid: vector<vector<int>>, nonempty rectangular, legal values0..7 or255; retain eligible and surviving labels unchanged
typed_api_boundary: int labels, bool flags and uint64 IDs/width do not expose Python dynamic-type checks; external parsers must reject illegal textual types, negative/overflow IDs and illegal booleans before constructing typed values
physical_ids: uint64 y*width+x; all uint64 values permitted by standalone sampling if actual decoded steps are valid; native grid products/conversions must be checked before overflow
records: Python-named evidence records contain value-owned vectors; caller mutation after factory return cannot change the saved snapshot. C++ result structs themselves are mutable values, not frozen Python dataclasses; only unmodified factory evidence is promised to later adapters.
thinning: Zhang-Suen exact N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW neighborhood with graph exterior0; two synchronous subiterations, first batch committed before second; keep terminating(0,0) round
graph: All eight-neighbor undirected edges exactly once; maximal trails through degree2 nodes stop at first nondegree2 endpoint; isolated nodes retained
returning_cycles: Returning trail to same junction is closed/returning, with closing edge but no repeated endpoint physical ID; remaining degree2 components are closed/nonreturning
canonical: Open full sequence min(forward,reverse); closed all rotation/reverse minimum; sort(sequence,closed) before stable chain-ID assignment
sampling: Axis1000, diagonal1414; 2000*k strictly below exact total selects first reached real vertex; open endpoints retained; closed total includes closing edge, markers there select next first node; deduplicate in original chain order
ownership: Lowest chain ID among chains sampling a physical point owns its score once; original full topology/sampling retained even for zero-owned chains; owned evidence sorted physical-ID with original owner full-chain index
weights: Global owned bbox uses exact integer4x4 cells; GMP mpz_class arclength, LCM, positive weights and denominator; denominator=C*LCM, exact sum of all weights
whole_empty_template: std::invalid_argument, including grids erased completely by thinning; all-invalid scene thinning/extraction remains legal
sample_validation: std::invalid_argument for width0, empty chain, duplicate IDs/repeated endpoint, non8-neighbor steps including closing edge, closed cycle shorter than3, returning flag on open chain; maximality/provenance outside standalone sampler
initial_stubs: All four functions return fixed default values without validation, algorithms, or input-dependent behavior. Parent must retain compiled actual normal-failure RED before authorizing implementation.
test_coverage: Literal tiny thinning/deletion counts, open/cyclic/returning/full-edge canonical chains, arclength marker boundaries, nonmonotonic sample order, ownership/zero-owned chain, bbox cell weights, invalid typed inputs, uint64-max sampling IDs, and isolated-grid53-primorial LCM exceeding uint64
